text: In San Francisco, health department scientist Elizabeth Driscoll [brings home a fragrant pink flower|trigger|bringing something home], and the next morning her boyfriend Geoffrey is cold and distant, like [an impostor wearing his face|threat|impostors and doubles]. With her colleague Matthew Bennell she finds a half-formed body growing near her bedroom, while across the city people turn blank and emotionless. Alien pods wait for every sleeper, and the few still human must [stay awake and hide every feeling|rules|break the rule and pay] to survive.
